words.example: The bank will not issue an acquittance until the last installment clears.
words.exampleZh: 最後一期入帳之前，銀行不會開清償證明。
words.notes: acquittance of a debt 是債務解除。

words.example: Affix the revenue stamp before the form leaves the counter.
words.exampleZh: 表格離開櫃檯前，先把印花貼上。
words.notes: affix a signature 是簽名。

words.example: The amount on the slip does not match the cash in the drawer.
words.exampleZh: 傳票上的金額和抽屜裡的現金不符。
words.notes: amount to 是總計達到。a large amount of 後接不可數名詞。

words.example: He had to autograph the new card before it would work.
words.exampleZh: 新卡要他當面簽名之後才會啟用。
words.notes: 可作名詞，也可作動詞，表示親筆簽名。

words.example: Your balance is too low for this transfer.
words.exampleZh: 你的餘額不夠這筆轉帳。
words.notes: keep a balance 是保持平衡，或維持足夠餘額。

words.example: The banker asked for the deed before discussing the loan.
words.exampleZh: 銀行家先要看產權文件，才談這筆貸款。
words.notes: 在銀行裡決定放款或客戶事務的人。

words.example: The machine dispensed one banknote and a handful of coins.
words.exampleZh: 機器吐出一張紙幣和一把硬幣。
words.notes: 紙鈔。硬幣是 coin。

words.example: Only the bearer can collect the cash on this note.
words.exampleZh: 只有持票人能領這張票據上的現金。
words.notes: bearer share 是無記名股份。

words.example: The bill lists a fee that was not in the contract.
words.exampleZh: 帳單上有一筆合約裡沒有的費用。
words.notes: pay a bill 是付帳。

words.example: The branch holds about one billion in deposits.
words.exampleZh: 這家分行的存款大約有十億。
words.notes: 可說 three billion，或 billions of。

words.example: Sign on the blank line, not across the printed total.
words.exampleZh: 簽在空白行上，不要簽在印好的總額上面。
words.notes: blank cheque 是空白支票。

words.example: Once the borrower misses two payments, the file goes to collections.
words.exampleZh: 借款人若兩期未付，檔案就轉去催收。
words.notes: 向銀行或他人借錢的一方。

words.example: You can pay at any branch, not only the one that opened the account.
words.exampleZh: 任何分行都能繳，不限開戶那一家。
words.notes: a branch of 是……的分支。

words.example: He kept the loan file in a locked briefcase.
words.exampleZh: 他把貸款檔案放在上鎖的公事包裡。
words.notes: 裝文件的手提公事包。

words.example: The teller will cash the cheque only if the date is still valid.
words.exampleZh: 日期仍有效，出納才會兌現這張支票。
words.notes: pay in cash 是付現。

words.example: The bank returned the cheque because the date had passed.
words.exampleZh: 日期過了，銀行把支票退回來。
words.notes: 英式拼法 cheque。美式拼法是 check。

words.example: The rate change will concern every saver at this branch.
words.exampleZh: 利率調整會影響這家分行的每位儲戶。
words.notes: be concerned about 是擔心。concern about 是對……的關切。

words.example: The new fee annoyed many a consumer who rarely visits the branch.
words.exampleZh: 新手續費讓很多很少進分行的客戶不高興。

words.example: Please take a number and wait at the counter.
words.exampleZh: 請抽號碼牌，在櫃檯等候。
words.notes: at the counter 是在櫃檯。

words.example: A late payment will hurt your credit with this bank.
words.exampleZh: 遲付會損害你在這家銀行的信用。
words.notes: credit card 是信用卡。作動詞是記入貸方。

words.example: Several currencies fell after the rate announcement.
words.exampleZh: 利率消息出來後，好幾種貨幣都下跌。
words.notes: out of currency 是不再通用。

words.example: The bank will debit the fee on the first of the month.
words.exampleZh: 銀行會在每月一號把這筆費用記入借方。
words.notes: debit note 是借項通知單。

words.example: The shop is in debt to two suppliers and the bank.
words.exampleZh: 這家店欠兩家供應商和銀行的錢。
words.notes: 指負債狀態時多不可數。a debt 是一筆債。

words.example: The bank can claim the debtor's pledged house.
words.exampleZh: 銀行可以主張債務人抵押的房子。
words.notes: 欠錢的一方。債權人是 creditor。

words.example: He will default on the loan if this month's transfer fails.
words.exampleZh: 這個月的轉帳若失敗，他就會對這筆貸款違約。
words.notes: default on 是在某義務上違約。

words.example: The ATM is out of every small denomination.
words.exampleZh: 自動櫃員機各種小面額都沒了。
words.notes: change denomination 是更換幣值。也可指宗教派別。

words.example: Deposit the cash before the counter closes at three.
words.exampleZh: 三點櫃檯關門前把現金存進去。
words.notes: deposit some money 是存一筆錢。也可指定金。

words.example: The currency began to depreciate after the rate cut.
words.exampleZh: 降息之後，這個貨幣開始貶值。
words.notes: depreciate 後面可直接接受詞。

words.example: I see no difference between the two repayment schedules.
words.exampleZh: 這兩種還款表我看不出差別。
words.notes: tell the difference 是分辨差異。

words.example: Discard the old passbook only after the new one is activated.
words.exampleZh: 新存摺啟用之後，舊的才能丟掉。
words.notes: discard 也可作名詞，表示丟棄的東西。

words.example: Ask for the duration before you sign the deposit slip.
words.exampleZh: 簽定存單之前，先問清楚期間。
words.notes: for the duration 是在整段期間內。

words.example: Card spending this month must not exceed the limit.
words.exampleZh: 這個月的刷卡金額不得超過額度。
words.notes: exceed ... in 是在某方面超過。

words.example: The desk will exchange the notes only with a passport.
words.exampleZh: 窗口只在有護照時才兌換這些現鈔。
words.notes: exchange A for B 是把 A 換成 B。

words.example: The wire fee is a small expense next to the transfer itself.
words.exampleZh: 電匯手續費和匯款本身比起來是筆小費用。
words.notes: expenses 常指開銷。

words.example: The gross pay on the slip is before any deduction.
words.exampleZh: 單上的薪資總額還沒扣任何款項。
words.notes: gross margin 是毛利率。gross weight 是總重。

words.example: Lending without a guarantee is a hazard the branch will not take.
words.exampleZh: 沒有擔保的放款，這家分行不願承擔那種風險。

words.example: Interest on the savings account fell again this quarter.
words.exampleZh: 儲蓄帳戶的利息這一季又降了。
words.notes: charge interest 是收利息。keep up an interest 是保持興趣。作「利息」時多不可數。

words.example: The branch will issue a new card if the chip fails.
words.exampleZh: 晶片故障的話，分行會核發新卡。
words.notes: issue 作名詞也可指一期刊物，或一個問題。

words.example: The lender wants an updated income slip before Friday.
words.exampleZh: 貸方要在星期五前拿到更新的收入證明。
words.notes: moneylender 多指放高利貸的人。

words.example: He cannot repay the loan without selling the shop.
words.exampleZh: 不把店賣掉，他就還不了這筆貸款。
words.notes: pay off a loan 是還清貸款。

words.example: The margin on this personal loan is thinner than last year.
words.exampleZh: 這項個人貸款的利差比去年薄。
words.notes: in the margin 是在頁面空白處。

words.example: The deposit has matured, so you can move the money today.
words.exampleZh: 這筆定存已經到期，今天就可以把錢轉走。
words.notes: matured bond 是到期債券。

words.example: They turned to a moneylender after the bank refused the file.
words.exampleZh: 銀行拒絕這件申請後，他們去找放款人。
words.notes: 多指銀行以外、以放款為業的人。

words.example: The bank will not lend unless the house is under mortgage.
words.exampleZh: 房子沒有抵押，銀行就不借。
words.notes: house in mortgage 是已抵押的房子。

words.example: A bonus on recovered loans will motivate the collections team.
words.exampleZh: 收回貸款有獎金，會激勵催收小組。
words.notes: motivate sb to do 是促使某人去做。

words.example: The refund will offset the fee charged last week.
words.exampleZh: 退款會抵掉上週收的那筆費用。
words.notes: offset 的過去式通常仍是 offset。

words.example: The overdraft fee depends on how far the balance went below zero.
words.exampleZh: 透支費要看餘額低於零多少。
words.notes: overdraft facility 是透支額度。

words.example: The owner checks the passbook once a month.
words.exampleZh: 所有人每個月核對一次存摺。
words.notes: property owner 是財產所有人。

words.example: I want the balance printed in my passbook, not only on the screen.
words.exampleZh: 我要餘額印在存摺上，不要只顯示在螢幕。
words.notes: savings passbook 是儲蓄存摺。

words.example: Enter the password again before the transfer is sent.
words.exampleZh: 匯款送出前再輸入一次密碼。
words.notes: 登入或確認交易時輸入的密碼。

words.example: Ask what poundage the transfer will cost before you send it.
words.exampleZh: 匯出前先問這筆匯款的手續費是多少。
words.notes: extra poundage 是額外手續費。charge poundage 是收取手續費。

words.example: The warning is printed prominently above the signature line.
words.exampleZh: 警告文字明顯印在簽名欄上方。

words.example: The queue at the counter reached the door by ten.
words.exampleZh: 十點不到，櫃檯前的隊伍已經排到門口。
words.notes: make a queue 是排成一列。考試裡多作名詞。

words.example: The posted rate changed twice this week.
words.exampleZh: 公告利率這週改了兩次。
words.notes: current rate 是當前利率。interest rate 是利率。

words.example: The fee came back as a refund the next morning.
words.exampleZh: 這筆手續費隔天早上退了回來。
words.notes: demand a refund 是要求退款。

words.example: How much will the bank remit after the fee?
words.exampleZh: 扣掉手續費後，銀行會匯出多少？
words.notes: remit 也可指免除款項。名詞 remittance 是匯款。

words.example: The remittance number on the slip does not match our record.
words.exampleZh: 單上的匯款編號和我們的紀錄不符。
words.notes: outward remittance 是匯出匯款。

words.example: She will repay the loan from the sale of the shares.
words.exampleZh: 她會用賣股票的錢償還這筆貸款。
words.notes: 過去式是 repaid。repay sb 是還某人錢。

words.example: The lowest repayment still takes a full year.
words.exampleZh: 就算選最低還款額，也要整整一年。
words.notes: repayment period 是還款期間。

words.example: By June the branch had gained about four hundred new savers.
words.exampleZh: 到六月，這家分行大約多了四百位儲戶。
words.notes: life saver 是救生員，和銀行無關。

words.example: She moved half of her savings into a one-year deposit.
words.exampleZh: 她把一半存款轉進一年期定存。
words.notes: 字尾的 s 要留著。savings bank 是儲蓄銀行。

words.example: They chose dollars as the settlement currency.
words.exampleZh: 他們選定以美元作為結算貨幣。
words.notes: clearing and settlement 是清算與結算。

words.example: The bank offered a substitute card while the chip was replaced.
words.exampleZh: 晶片更換期間，銀行給了一張替代卡。
words.notes: substitute A for B 是用 A 代替 B。

words.example: This deposit term is suitable for money you can leave untouched.
words.exampleZh: 這段定存期間適合你可以放著不動的錢。
words.notes: suitable for 是適合某人或某用途。

words.example: A large sum left the account just after midnight.
words.exampleZh: 午夜剛過，有一大筆錢離開了帳戶。
words.notes: a sum of money 是一筆錢。

words.example: The bank asked his brother to stand as surety.
words.exampleZh: 銀行要他哥哥擔任保證人。
words.notes: surety bond 是擔保保證。

words.example: The total of the two transfers is higher than the balance.
words.exampleZh: 兩筆匯款的總數高於餘額。
words.notes: a total of 後接數字。

words.example: Today's rate sheet is unavailable until the desk opens.
words.exampleZh: 今天的利率表要等窗口開始營業才拿得到。
words.notes: goods unavailable 是無貨可供。

words.example: The underwriter wants the bond details before noon.
words.exampleZh: 承保人中午前要拿到債券細節。
words.notes: insurance underwriter 是保險承保人。

words.example: This card is not unlimited; the ceiling is printed on the letter.
words.exampleZh: 這張卡不是無限額，上限印在通知信上。
words.notes: unlimited 常用來修飾名詞，如 unlimited liability 無限責任。

words.example: The branch will not fund a deal that looks like usury.
words.exampleZh: 這家分行不會資助看起來像高利貸的交易。
words.notes: take usury 是放高利貸。

words.example: There have been two variations in the posted rate this month.
words.exampleZh: 這個月公告利率有過兩次變動。
words.notes: without variation 是沒有變化。

words.example: Clients may withdraw up to this limit without calling the branch.
words.exampleZh: 在這個額度內，客戶不必打電話給分行就能提領。
words.notes: 過去式 withdrew，過去分詞 withdrawn。例句若要用字頭，就用 withdraw。

words.example: A withdrawal above this limit needs the passbook.
words.exampleZh: 超過這個金額的提款需要存摺。
words.notes: cash withdrawal 是現金提領。
